tickets.title: Start intake for a new joint taxable account
tickets.text: Start intake for Nora and Caleb Thimblefern’s new joint taxable account funded from their excess cash reserve. Collect ownership and risk profile information before preparing paperwork.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2025-08-05 to start intake for a new joint taxable account funded from excess cash reserve, with ownership and risk profile information to be collected before paperwork is prepared.

tickets.title: Document household intentions before updating beneficiary and transfer-on-death forms
tickets.text: Document Nora and Caleb Thimblefern’s current household intentions before updating beneficiary and transfer-on-death forms. Address the review finding that Nora’s IRA, 401(k), and taxable account records still list pre-marriage beneficiaries or no contingent beneficiary.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2025-08-15 to document current household intentions before updating beneficiary and transfer-on-death forms, after a review found Nora’s IRA, 401(k), and taxable account records still list pre-marriage beneficiaries or no contingent beneficiary.

tickets.title: Obtain proof of marriage
tickets.text: Obtain Nora Thimblefern’s proof of marriage for the custodian’s name and household registration updates. Nora had not uploaded the certificate through the secure portal.
tickets.evidence: Proof of marriage remains needed by 2025-08-01 because the custodian requires it for certain name and household registration updates, and Nora had not uploaded the certificate through the secure portal.

tickets.title: Refresh the monthly cash flow worksheet
tickets.text: Refresh the monthly cash flow worksheet using Nora and Caleb Thimblefern’s combined pay and the reserve target. Include Caleb’s student loan payment and the townhouse mortgage in one household plan.
tickets.evidence: They agreed by 2025-08-20 to refresh the monthly cash flow worksheet using combined pay and the reserve target because Caleb’s student loan payment and the townhouse mortgage will now be considered in one household plan.
